policy.REV-P1: No-show fee requires at least 480 seconds of verified continuous waiting at designated pickup before cancellation.
policy.REV-P2: Reverse existing fee when verified records establish cancellation before required duration, using backend-verified reversal amount.

evidence.REV-E1: Rider reports early cancellation and requests reversal.
evidence.REV-E2: Driver reports waiting long enough and requests retention.
evidence.REV-E3: Authenticated complete records verify continuous correct-location presence 08:43:00 to cancellation at 08:47:00 +08:00, no gaps.
evidence.REV-E4: Backend verified total duration 240 seconds, below 480-second requirement.
evidence.REV-E5: Verified existing charge 500 SGD cents; backend-verified reversal amount 500 cents; no reversal executed.

inputSummary.advocateSubmissions: Both briefs and rebuttals supplied. Rider cites REV-E4 and REV-P1/P2 for reversal; driver reports sufficient waiting but concedes verified duration is insufficient. Both acknowledge correct location.

observed.explanation: The verified records establish the driver was present at the correct pickup point but waited for a total of 240 seconds before the cancellation was recorded. This duration is below the 480-second threshold required by policy to justify a no-show fee. The applicable policy directs reversal of an existing fee when verified records show cancellation before the required waiting duration. Although the driver reports waiting long enough, this account is not supported by the authenticated records. Therefore, the reversal of the fee is supported.

findings.text: Authenticated records verify continuous driver presence at the correct pickup point from 08:43:00 until recorded cancellation at 08:47:00, establishing the driver was at the designated location.
The backend verified the total waiting duration before cancellation as 240 seconds, which is below the 480-second requirement specified in policy for a no-show fee.

Policy REV-P2 states to reverse an existing no-show fee when verified records establish cancellation before the required waiting duration. Since the verified waiting duration of 240 seconds is below the 480-second requirement, this rule applies.
